questions.stem: Why are germinating seeds better than dormant seeds for investigating respiration rate?

options.text: Germinating seeds are actively growing and have a higher respiration rate
Dormant seeds do not contain glucose
Germinating seeds do not produce carbon dioxide

questions.explanation: Germinating seeds are actively growing and dividing, so they need more energy and have a much higher rate of respiration than dormant seeds. This makes changes easier to measure.
